description: WHEN: use it whenever the traveller asks "what do you have from X to Y for N people" or shows date flexibility. WHAT IT RETURNS: `matches[]` with one entry per available category (G1..G6, G4B) ordered by total price, including name, zone (beach/city), bedrooms, m², highlights, location summary, photos, total/nightly EUR price (public rate, no discount code) and a `booking_url` with dates+pax prefilled. Also `alternatives[]` (up to 6, each with `reason` like "same dates, other category" or "2 days earlier, same category") when matches are empty or `flexible_days > 0`, `minimum_stay_only[]` for categories that would be available with a longer stay, `no_results_reason` when nothing applies, and `trust` (rating 9.4/10, 320+ Booking reviews, cheaper than Booking.com, Stripe payment, 14-day free cancellation, languages supported). Direct prices are BELOW Booking.com for the same dates. FLEXIBLE PARAMETERS: `flexible_days` (0–3, default 0) shifts the check-in by ±N days to broaden alternatives; `budget_eur` filters matches and alternatives by TOTAL EUR; `zone` ("beach" | "city" | "any", default "any"); `min_bedrooms` (default 1 — a sofa bed does not count). EXAMPLE: {"check_in":"2027-05-22","check_out":"2027-05-27","adults":4,"flexible_days":2,"budget_eur":900,"zone":"beach","min_bedrooms":2}.

budget_eur.description: Max TOTAL price in EUR for the whole stay. Filters both matches and alternatives.

check_out.description: Departure date (YYYY-MM-DD, Europe/Madrid); must be strictly after check_in.

children.description: Optional list of children ages. Only the count is used to size the property.

flexible_days.description: Shift the check-in by ±N days (0..3) to find alternatives if the exact dates are not available. Default 0.

language.description: Response language. Defaults to en if omitted or unsupported.

min_bedrooms.description: Minimum number of bedrooms (1 by default — a sofa bed does not count).

zone.description: Filter by zone: beach = La Patacona (G1..G5, G4B); city = Valencia city (G6); any = both (default).

name: search_availability

alternatives.description: Up to 6 alternatives (other dates ±flexible_days or other categories) when matches are empty or the agent asked for flexibility.

minimum_stay_only.description: Properties that would be available if the stay met the minimum-nights rule.

no_results_reason.description: Human-readable reason when both matches and alternatives are empty (e.g. all over minimum_stay or over budget).

title: Search availability
